verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a OneDrive bulk export or takeout feature, and says nothing about open export formats or a supported exit path. What it does document is adjacent only: Microsoft Graph file APIs and delta queries are developer building blocks, and 'Always keep on this device' is an offline-access setting, not a data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
